description:
The IT System Administrator will provide support to employees using the ticketing system, e-mail, chat.

Keeps the tickets updated with detailed information.  Duties will include but not be limited to:

  • Manages the employees' equipment (PCs, laptops, printers, scanners, projectors, monitors, peripherals etc.).
  • Deploys new equipment, assigns it to employees, keeps documents for tracking. Orders new equipment, manages warranty issues. 
  • Orders and installs required software.
  • Manages the local infrastructure:(Hardware: network equipment, cabling) (Security: Active Directory, Google Enterprise, Microsoft etc.)
  • Provides IT support for employees using the ticketing system, e-mail, chat. Keeps the tickets updated with detailed information.
  • Provides support/guidance for the external IT Level 1 support agents when needed.

Required Knowledge:

  • Windows, Windows Server 2008 R2, Windows Server 2016+
  • TCP/IP networking skills (subnets, minimal routing)
  • English at good conversational level
